description: The URL is the only copy of view state such as filters, sort, page and tab. Components derive it during render and write it back through navigation, never through a store.
One definition per screen of its query keys with type, default and validation. `parse` turns untrusted params into a typed object; `serialize` turns the object back into params.
Turning the raw strings of a query string into numbers, enum values and arrays, with a default when the value is missing or invalid.
The single string chosen for a view: defaults omitted, keys and list items in a stable order. Equal views get equal URLs, so caches, query keys and search engines see one entry.
`push` adds a history entry that back can undo (sort, tab, page). `replace` rewrites the current entry (typing, normalizing a link).
Policy that sends pagination back to the first page whenever a filter changes, so a narrower result set never lands on an empty page.
